trickyParts: codeColumns.Close keeps goldmark's trim for code right after a list or a quote with no blank line before it (heldOpenBefore, shared with interruptsOpenBlock), so refusals.go's line count is main's

Held lines are only the lines past goldmark's trimmed end (codeHeldAttr); internal code lines and fenced code keep main's spacing treatment; holdCodeLines sets blankAfterAttr=false on the block right after the last held line from the held set, after lazyTableRows
codeBlockText drops at most two final line feeds (the last line's own, then mdast's one line ending)
deviations:
T1's list-item row expected "   x
  
"; the engine reads "    x
  
 ", which the rule gives; the test pins the engine's value

Fenced-code fix added: two of INFRA-581's 30 accepted documents still misread at the head because of a pre-existing fenced-code defect in pmdoc (a whitespace-only line short of the fence's indent); fixed here with fenced_code_test.go and a fixture

Of INFRA-581's 30 accepted documents, 25 are fixtures; 5 stay in the differential corpus only because TestRenderMatchesMilkdownForFixtures's plain-text normaliser cannot compare their code text (=== and 1. lines inside code)
Red runs and comparisons use base f45c6716 (main after #2403) rather than the fork point 1767c9af/cc5ccf19, whose pmdoc test package did not compile; the pmdoc reader is identical

The branch carried the two pmdoc compile fixes main needed (reanchor_test.go NestedValue from docs/crafted, typed_nesting_test.go cpuTimeOf(again(...))); main now has both through #2482 and #2484 (opened from this session as a separate PR at the controller's direction)

Round 2: a comment line in the tester's fenced_code_test.go changed from 'INFRA-581's' to 'sjawhar/legion#2403's generator' under the controller's no-key ruling; no row or assertion of the tester's changed
Round 2: the census was not re-crawled; the round-2 change reads only documents without a final line feed, of which production stores none (tester's crawl)

Round 3: the whole-corpus differential runs against a09a2f25 (the branch's base reader); against main 8a911ecc it shows url regressions from #2373, which the branch has not merged (no conflict, no merge needed); the tester's noeol corpus ran against 8a911ecc itself, every GATE line 0
discoveredComplexity: 39 of INFRA-581's 69 documents (all of round 5) are refused at main and at the head by #2403's remaining refusal of a footnote definition inside a typed block; they stay in the differential corpus
